name: Symbiont Bearer
body:
You can bond with additional symbionts.

Prerequisite(s): Symbiont Handler, Handle Animal 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You may bond with one additional symbiont regardless of your Constitution bonus.

Normal: You can bond with a number of symbionts equal to your Constitution bonus (minimum 1).

Special: You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select this feat, its effects stack.
